task.description: Diagnose ISS-0158 / GH #479: determine why transition() reportedly emits no effect_emitted for SERVICE_TASK, and reconcile against the possible duplicate GH #515 / ISS-0182.
acceptance_criteria: Failing blocks reproduced and named exactly
Root cause read from source, not guessed

result.summary: Premise in #479 corrected: transition() DOES emit effect_emitted for SERVICE_TASK. The reported symptom was the dangling-graph fixture bug already fixed under GH #439/#490 (commit 8103072). Reproduced 13 failing blocks against a verified-healthy db_test on :5453 (the process env carried a stale BPM_TEST_DB_URL on :5434 which test-env-verify caught before any measurement). Identified 5 independent memory-ownership root causes, 4 of them in production source. GH #515 confirmed a duplicate of #479: same file, same 13 blocks.
